reason.text: Lafayette is spending down part of its reserve on purpose, to catch up on long-standing maintenance of its buildings, parks and trails while its reserve is strong and Measure H sales-tax money is coming in.

cites.quote: The City Council Finance Subcommittee recommends prioritizing funding the City’s long-standing deferred maintenance needs while reserves remain strong, and Measure H revenues are available.
Accordingly, the budget includes an additional annual contribution of $500K to Fund 16 for the Community Center sinking fund.
